fresh_primary_sources.use: Counter is a dict subclass; keys are elements, values are counts, total() sums counts, while list/iteration exposes unique keys.
Python defines arbitrary comparison chaining as adjacent comparisons with single evaluation of each expression.
Julia permits chaining but explicitly leaves evaluation order undefined.
Rust requires parentheses; unparenthesized comparison chaining is invalid.
PROV validation constrains consistent relational history; used only as provenance architecture analogy.
Trace IDs identify/propagate distributed traces; correlation context is not causal authority.
Runtime library version and source-id interfaces bind the loaded library, not merely headers.
WAL recovery and durability depend on process/connection/checkpoint behavior; close/reopen is not power-loss proof.
Current upstream multimodal implementation provides mechanism context only; it is not Frank target evidence.

hypotheses.claim: Every numeric evidence field crossing an evidence or promotion boundary must encode the counted entity and aggregation operator; ambiguous totals are invalid.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A legacy alias plus documentation is sufficient and typed field names add no safety.
hypotheses.falsifier: Generate Counters with duplicate, zero and negative counts; require schema validators and consumers to distinguish key cardinality, signed total and positive occurrence total, reject ambiguous keys, preserve old receipts as classified history, and round-trip migrations without relabeling evidence.

hypotheses.claim: The three remaining chained-!= lines express non-collapse of semantic dimensions, not necessarily runtime all-different value comparisons; equal runtime values may still inhabit distinct semantic types.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: They are executable runtime invariants whose all-different, adjacent-pair or left-fold semantics must be selected.
hypotheses.falsifier: Require explicit documentary-versus-executable annotation. For documentary lines test type-level non-unifiability with equal-value fixtures; for executable lines owner-fix semantics and run discriminating adjacent/all-different/left-fold/forbidden-chain cases before parser admission.

hypotheses.claim: A terminal consumer may consume immutable causal support produced from coherent prior execution/outcome/GWT/use/prediction/credit history, but may not mint the support it is proving.

hypotheses.falsifier: Kill the full process after producer admission and before terminalization on a fixed database path; the exact coherent chain must recover while wrong-subject, wrong-outcome, correlated-only and cross-cycle-splice chains remain rejected.

hypotheses.claim: GWT causal credit is durable only when relational ancestry survives both adversarial causal splices and runtime-object-bound full-process recovery.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Either relational splice resistance or storage/runtime recovery alone is sufficient.
hypotheses.falsifier: Compose the PR280 V17 producer path through the PR324 admitted SQLite object, then execute a cross-product of valid/invalid ancestry and graceful-close/process-kill/restart cases on exact SHA and artifact hashes.

hypotheses.claim: Every downstream state consumer, reopened connection and child process must inherit and emit the exact admitted runtime-object identity; one parent-process receipt is insufficient.

hypotheses.claim: Binding temporal_policy_hash into the Python/runtime FeatureEpoch prevents silent reuse of MVC prototypes across temporal/frame-processing policy changes.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: For the still-image-only operating subset, temporal policy is observationally irrelevant and the added dimension only causes false invalidation.

Remove the dimension only if equivalence is demonstrated.

hypotheses.claim: The count bug, caller-minted causal IDs, unpropagated SQLite object identity and omitted temporal policy are one failure class: an identity aliases states when a dimension that can change admissibility is absent or untyped.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: These are unrelated local bugs; a shared identity discipline will overfit and reduce availability.
hypotheses.falsifier: Run a preregistered ablation matrix over metric aggregation, causal producer ancestry, runtime object and temporal policy. Each omitted relevant dimension must produce a predicted alias/splice; each irrelevant added dimension must expose measurable false rejection. Reject the concept if it lacks cross-domain predictive gain.
